evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep opens with 'Do you have about ten minutes to kind of run through some details with me? Okay, perfect.' — no time-boxed framing or promise of dependable quote, no wait for a yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'Before I kind of get started here. Did you have the top of mind, questions or concerns that I can kind of kick us off with?' — asked early, before probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'I'm just kind of researching at the moment. So, so I'm just kind of looking at what, what's the kind of a structure and how many men that kind of thing.' Rep responds 'Okay. Yeah, of course.' and pivots to 'let me kind of get a little bit more information' — acknowledged but no real follow-up on the concern about structure/crew size.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary or reflection back of concerns. Rep never says 'So what I'm hearing is...' or anything similar.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covers property type (apartment to house), floor (first floor), rooms (two bedroom apartment), destination city, destination square footage (3500), stories (two story), placement detail (ground floor except one sofa), distance/drive time (25 min), and confirms no additional stops. All major logistics items present.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Customer volunteered 30 medium boxes, 7-8 suitcases, but rep never probed box count using the typical/overflow framework.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives anchored range: 'Generally for a two bedroom apartment...generally takes us about six to seven hours...but in this case...it's not gonna take the six to seven hours. So I'm getting this particular move...I'm gonna estimate 4:00 to five' and personalizes it to 'you don't have like...you gave me a complete inventory...one special consideration item.' Then translates to cost: '$862 to about 10:20.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses included items: 'What is included inside of that $2 and four is everything, the taxes, the insurance, the travel, all the wrapping, and pad...damage coverage...meet the mover feature...on time guarantee.' Also frames 'you do only pay for the time you use, so we have a two and a half hour minimum' and 'We don't have any hidden fees here.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or pauses for customer reaction to the price.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep states: 'the on time guarantee that just ensures that we arrive on time. And if we don't, then money is automatically deducted off of your final bill.' Covers discount terms in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep says: 'the know, where we damage coverage that covers up to $2,000 for kind of any incidentals you also have included' — mentions $2,000 and that it's included, but does not explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print' framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' after covering the two promises. Later Rep asks a generic 'Did you have any other questions or concerns about anything?' which is throwaway, and customer raises a new concern (assembly/disassembly), but the promises were not explicitly closed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Did you have any other questions or concerns about anything?' — this is empty/throwaway phrasing, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: Customer raises concern: 'I just wanted to confirm like does it also include assembling and disassembling like the beds.' Rep digs in: 'Yes sir, yes sir. That's standard service for us with no additional cost and then as well as, if we need to dismount TVs that's already included as well.' — genuine follow-up.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or anything equivalent. Instead rep says 'I'm gonna go ahead and send this email over to you' and 'I'm gonna get this over to you right now' — offering to email without explicitly asking for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep states: 'There's no deposit due, it's free to reserve our truck. It's free to cancel if you need to move it around...The X. free as well. So like, you don't pay for anything until after the move is completed and you can make changes all the way up to the move date.' — rate/booking modifications are mentioned but 'rate lock' as a guarantee is not explicitly stated.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking details confirmed. Rep only says 'I'm gonna send this email over to you' and offers contact info. No date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses, or notes confirmed. Customer says 'give me a few days to think about it' and closes without a booking.

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered comprehensive logistics details early and delivered a fully anchored, personalized estimate with complete pricing transparency and fee structure upfront, leaving no ambiguity about what's included or how payment works.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business — always offer to email instead of closing with an explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' and always confirm booking details and follow up with reflection and a genuine final-concerns check rather than throwaway 'any questions?'
